source.label: benin-cashews TACO repackaging (ISP-UV, Hugging Face)
source.method: centre of each of the 20 georeferenced 2.56 km label chips, from the GeoTIFF headers of the label chips read inside the zip over HTTP, EPSG:32631 -> WGS84

note: One Sentinel-2 scene in central Benin (Collines), 2019-11 to 2020-10. GEO-Bench m-cashew-plant has 1,800 samples but its HDF5 export gives every sample the same transform, so only the scene's 20-chip grid is plottable.
